precondition.description: The customer supplies an immutable Obsmetrologia baseline, a mathematical obligation, its corpus source, and exact verification requirements.

move.description: OML derives the mathematical change, uses Lean diagnostics and proof checks, performs the required axiom audit, and packages the delta and evidence without writing the customer's checkout.

postcondition.description: The customer receives a content-addressed proposal and evidence or a typed refusal; Obsmetrologia alone decides and records admission.
